results.segment: You have an appointment about your membership at Eastvale Library Service on 21 April 2026. Please arrive ten minutes early and bring this letter with you.
If you have any questions about this letter, our reception team will be glad to help.
A credit of £9.99 will appear on your next statement, which we expect to issue in early August.
